audience: developers who run durable functions on Inngest and debug failed runs

useCases.title: See the newest events received
useCases.text: The AI lists the latest events in the environment, newest first, and reads one event with its name, payload and timestamp.

useCases.title: Find which function runs an event started
useCases.text: The AI takes one event and lists every function run it triggered, with the status of each run. You see what the event did.

useCases.title: Find the failing step of a run and why it failed
useCases.text: The AI reads a run's status, output and error, and lists its steps with status and timing. You see which step failed and the error message.

useCases.title: Review the webhooks that turn into events
useCases.text: The AI lists the webhook ingresses of the environment and reads one with its URL and transform. You see which outside sources produce events.

useCases.title: Bulk cancel runs or stop a cancellation job
useCases.text: The AI cancels every run of one function that started in a time window, or deletes a cancellation job so it stops. It can first list your cancellation jobs and their progress.
